name: [Base] Single lowest group
input: Alice and Bob share Search; Alice and Carol share Engineering
test:
company = Node('Company')
engineering = Node('Engineering', [company])
search = Node('Search', [engineering])
alice = Node('Alice', [search])
bob = Node('Bob', [search])
carol = Node('Carol', [engineering])
assert closest_common_groups([alice, bob]) == {search}
assert closest_common_groups([alice, carol]) == {engineering}

name: [DAG] Incomparable common groups
input: Alice and Bob both have parents A and B; return both
test:
company = Node('Company')
a = Node('A', [company])
b = Node('B', [company])
alice = Node('Alice', [a, b])
bob = Node('Bob', [a, b])
result = closest_common_groups([alice, bob])
assert isinstance(result, set)
assert result == {a, b}
assert closest_common_groups([bob, alice]) == {a, b}

name: [Multiple employees] Later employee narrows the answer
input: Alice and Bob share A and B; Carol belongs only to B

name: [Reachability] Transitive ancestors and shortcut edges
input: Redundant direct links must not make higher groups lowest
test:
top = Node('Top')
middle = Node('Middle', [top])
low = Node('Low', [middle])
alice = Node('Alice', [top, low])
bob = Node('Bob', [middle, low])
assert closest_common_groups([alice, bob]) == {low}
# Both are lowest even though their distances from the top differ.
x = Node('X', [top])
deep = Node('Deep', [middle])
p = Node('P', [x, deep])
q = Node('Q', [x, deep])
assert closest_common_groups([p, q]) == {x, deep}

name: [DAG] Shared paths require all parents
input: One employee reaches Company through two branches; the other uses another branch
test:
company = Node('Company')
left = Node('Left', [company])
right = Node('Right', [company])
bridge = Node('Bridge', [left, right])
alice = Node('Alice', [left, bridge])
bob = Node('Bob', [right])
assert closest_common_groups([alice, bob]) == {right}
carol = Node('Carol', [company])
assert closest_common_groups([alice, carol]) == {company}

name: [Disconnected] No common group
input: Separate roots, including a three-employee query whose pairwise overlaps differ
test:
a, b, c = Node('A'), Node('B'), Node('C')
p = Node('P', [a, b])
q = Node('Q', [b, c])
r = Node('R', [a, c])
assert closest_common_groups([p, q]) == {b}
assert closest_common_groups([p, q, r]) == set()
isolated = Node('Isolated', [Node('Other root')])
assert closest_common_groups([p, isolated]) == set()

name: [Contract] Identity and unchanged inputs
input: Different groups share the same name; queries must preserve all inputs
test:
top = Node('Same')
a = Node('Same', [top])
b = Node('Same', [top])
alice = Node('Employee', [a, b])
bob = Node('Employee', [a, b])
query = [bob, alice]
nodes = [top, a, b, alice, bob]
before = [(n.name, n.parents, tuple(n.parents)) for n in nodes]
saved_query = list(query)
assert closest_common_groups(query) == {a, b}
assert closest_common_groups([alice, bob]) == {a, b}
assert query == saved_query
for node, (name, parents, contents) in zip(nodes, before):
    assert node.name == name
    assert node.parents is parents
    assert tuple(node.parents) == contents
